outcome: Live birth rate per embryo transfer
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 3307 patients undergoing an ovum donation cycle in 2018-2019, divided into two groups: adenomyosis (n = 179) and controls (n = 3128)
finding: While adenomyosis was associated with a lower live birth rate per embryo transfer in ovum donation cycles, it did not significantly affect perinatal outcomes such as delivery method, gestational age, birth weight, or neonatal complications.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in childbirth delivery method (vaginal versus cesarean section) between the adenomyosis and control groups.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at the time of delivery was recorded (not specified)
